title: How Yoga Travelled from Ancient India to Every Corner of the World
description: Yoga began as a discipline rooted in Indian philosophy, practised in forest ashrams and passed down through oral tradition. Over centuries it moved through trade routes, colonial encounters, and the curiosity of Western seekers before becoming one of the most widely practised physical and contemplative systems on earth. The journey from a Sanskrit text to a studio in São Paulo is stranger and richer than most people realise.
